resolution: Audited all 13 screenshots and wrote §11 of the structure review (commit a9b09f2b3). Codified the user's four UX laws (L1 host sliders — verified NO native slider primitive exists, every slider is JS WorkbenchSlider; L2 no bare ± steppers — zoom/threshold steppers cited; L3 constrained widths; L4 one settings door — found THREE). Answered the 3-swatches/no-wheel question: the buildings source emits walls/roofs/props as three identical groups each with its own palette copy, while FieldSpec t:'color' already supports wheel+range (fields.tsx:40) — the fix is data, not new UI. Per-screenshot findings for all 13 (two categories both named FACADES, vehicles debug-jargon-as-UI, dead TV panel, 77-row ungrouped paint roster with hash names, animation 35-button chip wall already ruled against in req_0184, characters LAW-1 violated both directions, assist3d as the last pre-fold shell incl. a doubled-MODEL-input bug at BackendBar.tsx:70). Structural diagnosis: panels mirror the data shape, not the task — proposed an 8-rule PANEL GRAMMAR enforced in the one renderer (shell/fields.tsx + spec validator) so every source inherits the fix at once.
